facts.fact: South Sudan's ICT ministry invited international bids (SS-MICT&PS-544330-NC-RFB, bids closing 26 October 2026) for about 397 km of terrestrial fibre on the Juba-Nadapal route toward the Kenyan border, financed under World Bank grant E1780 of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project; this is procurement, not yet works, and the notice date is given as the report's 2026-09-14 publication.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services
systems.tiers: schools, health centres and government facilities within 10 km of the route
